mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend (num, status, requested_date, responsed_date, request_num, response_num) VALUES (friend_seq.NEXTVAL, 'PENDING', SYSDATE, NULL, #{request_num}, #{response_num})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend WHERE ((request_num = #{request_num} AND response_num = #{response_num}) OR (request_num = #{response_num} AND response_num = #{request_num})) AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED')

SELECT f.num, f.status, f.requested_date, f.responsed_date, f.request_num, f.response_num, m.member_nick AS counterpart_nick FROM friend f LEFT JOIN member m ON m.member_num = f.request_num WHERE f.response_num = #{response_num} AND f.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.num DESC

SELECT f.num, f.status, f.requested_date, f.responsed_date, f.request_num, f.response_num, m.member_nick AS counterpart_nick FROM friend f LEFT JOIN member m ON m.member_num = f.response_num WHERE f.request_num = #{request_num} ORDER BY f.num DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE friend SET status = 'ACCEPTED', responsed_date = SYSDATE WHERE num = #{num} AND response_num = #{response_num} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE friend SET status = 'REJECTED', responsed_date = SYSDATE WHERE num = #{num} AND response_num = #{response_num} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT num, status, requested_date, responsed_date, request_num, response_num FROM friend WHERE status = 'ACCEPTED' AND (request_num = #{member_num} OR response_num = #{member_num}) ORDER BY responsed_date DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM friend WHERE num = #{num} AND request_num = #{request_num} AND status = 'PENDING'
DELETE FROM friend WHERE num = #{num} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' AND (request_num = #{member_num} OR response_num = #{member_num})
